title: Performance Demo / Regular trees and HUD improvements
goal: Compare play with the HUD shown and hidden using Tab. Check immediate ammo updates, reload and entering or leaving the Warthog.
changes: Regular fir trees are restored with all painted placements preserved. Hidden HUD text no longer rebuilds every frame. The diagnostic panel refreshes ten times per second; ammo updates immediately when it changes. Low-poly tank and cloud improvements remain active.
controls: Tab hides/shows HUD; F8 starts/stops diagnostic recording. E enters/exits vehicles. LMB / R2 fires; R / Square reloads. 6 selects Rocket Launcher; Q / Triangle cycles weapons. B / L1 throws grenades. Ctrl+F3 opens sky controls; Ctrl+F9 toggles upper clouds; Ctrl+F12 cycles sky presets.
